  counts per status and the total weight shipped this week (Monday through
  today, inclusive: a shipped row dated in the future is a data-entry
  error and does not count toward it), all recomputed in SQL from the same
  table on each call. \`add\` inserts a shipment: destination, weight in kg,
  status, optional date (today by default).
- \`sql/001_items.sql\`, \`sql/002_shipments.sql\` — migrations. \`002\` replaces
  the scaffold \`items\` table with \`shipments\` (id, destination, weight_kg,
  status packed/shipped/delivered, date).
- \`fixtures/shipments-mixed.json\` — 32 realistic rows: 8 packed, 11
  shipped, 13 delivered, all dated March 2025. Because no shipped row
  falls in the current week, it also covers the edge case "a week with no
  shipped shipments at all" (this week's weight is 0).
  \`fixtures/shipments-empty.json\` covers a completely empty table, and
  \`fixtures/shipments-future-date.json\` holds two shipped rows inside the
  current week and two shipped rows dated in the future (data-entry
  errors), for the weekly-weight cap.
- \`scenarios/\` — the automatic checks. Each number the page shows is
  cross-checked against SQL over the actual rows: if the page says 11
